headline: Dell launches PowerEdge R7xx with improved power efficiency
key_points: Dell announced the PowerEdge R7xx series, a refresh of its two-socket rack server line.
The systems use a redesigned airflow path and higher-efficiency power supplies.
Dell reports reduced power draw at typical enterprise utilisation levels.
Availability is staged by region through the remainder of the quarter.
business_impact: Lower running costs for organisations planning a data centre refresh, offset against the migration effort across an existing estate.

headline: Quarterly threat report highlights shift in ransomware targeting
key_points: The quarterly report finds attackers increasingly targeting mid-sized organisations.
Initial access is most often gained through unpatched edge devices.
Median dwell time before detection has shortened compared with the previous quarter.
business_impact: Mid-market IT teams should prioritise edge device patching, which the report identifies as the most common entry point.
technical_facts: Edge device exploitation as primary initial access vector

headline: New managed service simplifies hybrid cloud networking
key_points: The service provides managed connectivity between on-premises estates and public cloud regions.
Configuration is handled through a single console rather than per-site setup.
Existing customers can migrate without re-addressing their networks.
business_impact: Reduces the operational overhead of running hybrid connectivity for teams without a dedicated network engineering function.
